in_sanskrit.name: परावेशन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who enters the heart and pervades it completely, granting Moksha. In Vaishnavism, Perumal is a name of Vishnu, who is believed to reside in the heart of every devotee.

in_hindi.name: परामात्मा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The supreme soul or the ultimate reality in Hinduism. Perumal can also refer to Vishnu in this context.

in_tamil.name: பெருமால்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Perumal is a name used to refer to Vishnu, who is considered the Lord of the Universe in Hinduism. It is also used to refer to any deity who is considered the supreme ruler of the universe.

in_telugu.name: పెరుమాలు
in_telugu.long_meaning: Perumal can also refer to a collective term for various deities, especially in the context of Vaishnavism. It is also used to refer to the supreme deity or the ultimate reality in Hinduism.

in_marathi.name: Perumal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Perumal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Perumal is derived from the Tamil word 'peru' meaning 'supreme' and 'mal' meaning 'lord'. This name is used to refer to Lord Vishnu, who is considered the supreme god in the Hindu religion.

This name is used to refer to Lord Vishnu, who is considered the supreme god in the Hindu religion.
